author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,
I would like to suggest a Web online time.
It's like the playtime on the profile, but for the forums.
I just want to see how long I'm on the forums xD Under the "Webtime" could be the amount of post and topics that a player made. So you don't have to put all your mothpost together :)
yea that's it, leave comments or improovments below.

Another suggestion: you can choose your best topics or recent topics as favourites and they will show highlighted on your profile page.

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body: This wouldn't be possible to code, unless you ping the server from your client every few seconds. If you're on your phone using data, that would blow your phone bill up in a few minutes. I don't think there is another way to code something like this, since on the server it records your log-in and log-out time, but you can't record the log-out time on a website.
